description: Compact coverage-oriented review sample exported from a larger official-Kubric batch run.
review_strategy: coverage-oriented shared-factor block sampling; each group contains multiple clips sharing camera or physics

shared_factor_group_policy.same_camera_groups: one exact camera trajectory and scene paired with multiple physics programs
shared_factor_group_policy.same_physics_scene_groups: one exact physics simulation and scene paired with multiple camera trajectories
shared_factor_group_policy.global_grid_policy: small local blocks are sampled for reusable supervision; the full global camera x physics cartesian product is not rendered

pair_contract.same_camera: all clips in a same-camera group reuse identical camera_frames, scene_id, fps, and frames_count; physics differs
pair_contract.same_physics_scene: all clips in a same-physics group reuse identical physics_frames, scene_id, fps, and frames_count; camera differs
pair_contract.length_policy: clips inside a group have identical length; different groups sample different lengths

camera_motion_model: camera endpoints, roll, lens, target drift, and orbit parameters are sampled from clipped Gaussian templates; speed_curve controls within-clip acceleration/deceleration
physics_sampling_model: object sizes, aspect ratios, masses, initial velocities, angular velocities, friction, restitution, colors, and material profiles are sampled from clipped Gaussian templates
quality_filters: Every accepted clip must pass expected-contact checks, physics plausibility audits, and camera framing audits before metadata or render jobs are accepted.

camera_framing_filter.requirement: at least one continuous segment where all dynamic object centers plus a small radius margin are inside the approximate camera frustum
camera_framing_filter.diagnostics: metadata also records strict_extent_visible with a larger body-radius margin
